body:
🤖 **Agent note** · Phase 4 closing ref inventory (task 12925, lane code-l)

Inventory taken at origin/main `165b652488` in `pm-stack/aggregator/src` (22 `refUrl(` sites incl. the definition, 5 `parseRef(` sites), plus the projector registry recount. Contract: `model.ts` beside the #4952 `isValidRef` comment — now also carrying the Phase 4 contract statement (PR linked below).

## Dispositions — refUrl sites

| Site (current) | Disposition |
|---|---|
| `model.ts` `refUrl` definition | By design: `parseRef` throw retained for code-built refs |
| `comments.ts:494` `githubCommentUrl` | **Gate-dropped (rule 2)** — see required disposition 3 |
| `sources/live.ts` `mapProjectorComment` | **Fixed in this phase** — rule 4 guard added; see disposition 2 |
| `sources/live.ts` Kaneo board link minting | **Fixed in this phase** — rule 3 producer gate + traced drop; a GitHub URL + `externalId` minted `${repo}#${externalId}` with no validity check (the #6205 second-vector shape) |
| `sources/live.ts` `titleRefs` | Producer-filtered; **drop-tracing added in this phase** (rule 2) — invalid candidates now reach the caller's trace via `onInvalid`; this also fixes a pre-existing `board-in-flight` test failure on main |
| `sources/fixtures.ts:48,230` | Internal-constructed-safe (fixture literals) |
| `project-config.ts:550` | Internal-constructed-safe (`code(309)`) |
| `queue-view.ts:113,144` | Guarded at call site (`isValidRef` ternary) — disposition 1 |
| `brief.ts:97` | Producer-filtered (`blockedBy.filter(isValidRef)` at :93) |
| `render.ts:515` | Guarded (plain-text badge otherwise) |
| `render.ts:1523` in-flight card links | Gate-dropped upstream (`inFlightBoardItems` add() gate; registry links via the #6211 read gate) |
| `render.ts` `sessionRecordLine` | Differs deliberately — disposition 5 |
| `render.ts:2550,2584,3433` | Guarded ternaries (plain `<code>`/text otherwise) |
| `render.ts` `ensure()` overview fallback | All signal paths gated — disposition 4 |
| `render.ts:6533` | The safe-link helper itself (`isValidRef` ? link : label) |
| `render.ts:6710` | Guarded (links via stored `issueUrl`) |
| `render.ts` roadmap-row links | Producer-filtered (`refsInText` at Grist read) + #6211 gate on registry enrichment |
| `render.ts` per-repo tracked refs | Internal-constructed-safe (config `trackedRefs`, validated by `validateProjectConfigs`/`checkRefs`, asserted in tests) |
| `program.ts:50,51` | Internal-constructed-safe (`issue(n)`) |

parseRef sites: definition + `isValidRef` internals + `refUrl` internals (by design); `sources/live.ts` in-flight `parseRef(remainingRefs[0])` — every candidate passed the `add()` `isValidRef` gate first; `project-config.ts` `checkRefs` — try/catch validation, throw retained as a test-time assertion.

## The seven required dispositions

1. **queue-view.ts:113,139** — now :113 and :144; both reach `refUrl` only under an `isValidRef` ternary. Closed.
2. **sources/live.ts session-row fallback** (`mapProjectorComment`, was :368) — the stored `row.url` wins; the `refUrl(row.ref)` fallback was unguarded against stored projector data. **Fixed in this phase:** fallback fires only when `isValidRef(row.ref)`, else no URL (never a throw). Empirical state: 0 invalid refs among 10,227 distinct `pmp_comments` refs (61,197 rows) in the live projector DB.
3. **comments.ts:494 `githubCommentUrl`** — answered: **no guard owed.** Every stored comment's `githubRef` is guaranteed valid by the store-load gate: `commentRecordProblem` rejects a `kind:"github"` record whose `githubRef` fails `isValidRef` (comments.ts:68), `doLoad` quarantines rejected records at load, and the creation path validates the same rule (`validateNewComment`, comments.ts:122). A load-surviving record cannot carry an invalid `githubRef`.
4. **render.ts `ensure()` fallback** (was :3574, now the overview `ensure`) **and :6756** — post-#6205 every `signal()` path is gated: lined-up refs and both title scrapes are `isValidRef`-guarded at the call sites; board links come only from gated producers (Kaneo mint — fixed this phase; in-flight `add()` gate; #6211 registry gate); pool rows always carry `issueUrl` (the feed gate `isProjectPoolItem` requires it), so the `refUrl` fallback is reachable only with refs from gated producers. The :6756-era rendering is today's roadmap/tracked link rendering — both dispositioned in the table above (producer-filtered / config-validated).
5. **sessionRecordLine** (was :1912) — **differs deliberately, recorded here:** its refs are registry `taskRefs`, already load-gated (`isSessionRecord` rejects a record carrying an invalid taskRef); the try/catch is defense-in-depth for in-memory poisoned records, and omission — not plain text — is the pinned treatment (`test/registry-taskrefs-2485.test.ts` asserts the malformed ref text does not appear in the line). A compact session line drops the annotation rather than printing an unparseable ref.
6. **pmp_links recount** — live projector DB (`~/.local/state/pm-projector/projector.db`, read 2026-11-08): **pmp_links holds 0 rows, so 0 refs fail `isValidRef`** (for scale: `pmp_items` 13,316 distinct refs, 0 invalid; `pmp_comments` above). No hand-deletion is owed; the standing protection is the projector POST gate + the aggregator #6211 read gate + Phase 2 consumption filtering, which disarm any future invalid row at read.
7. **Raw matchAll ref scrapes** — the only ref-shaped `matchAll` sites are `refsInText` (model.ts, `isValidRef`-filtered), `titleRefs` (filtered; tracing added this phase), and the overview title scrape in render.ts (`isValidRef`-guarded, the #6205 second vector). Every other `matchAll` in the tree is non-ref (dates, quota stamps, service-worker `clients.matchAll`). No unguarded ref scrape remains.

## Fixes landed in this phase (one PR, linked below)

- `model.ts`: the contract statement beside the #4952 comment (acceptance criterion 2).
- `sources/live.ts`: Kaneo mint gate; `mapProjectorComment` guard; `titleRefs` drop-tracing.
- `test/ref-contract-6243.test.ts`: pinning probes — bad-ref (unsafe-integer and non-GitHub) cases derive/render without a throw, valid-ref controls unchanged.

Tests (via the PR's CI + local `bun test`): new `test/ref-contract-6243.test.ts` 5/5 pass; related files pass (`projector`, `kaneo-project-repos-1201`, `registry-ref-filter-6211`, `registry-taskrefs-2485`, `board-in-flight` — the last was failing on clean main before this PR and is fixed by the titleRefs tracing change). An 18-file subset (digest/boot/source-gate/events/needs-user/…) matches clean main exactly: 108 pass / 14 fail on both, the 14 being pre-existing environment flakes. Note for future worktree runs: a fresh worktree needs `bun install` first — missing `node_modules` masquerades as digest-script test failures.

PR: https://github.com/developing-today/code/pull/7639 — Phase 4 completes when it merges; #6242 then closes with the four-phase evidence.

🤖 **Agent note** · Phase 4 closing inventory (task 13017, lane code-g)

**Method:** fresh enumeration at origin/main df0e415c91 (2026-11-08): every `refUrl(`/`parseRef(` site in `pm-stack/aggregator/src` (22 `refUrl` + 5 `parseRef` call sites outside model.ts itself, non-test), every `isValidRef` guard/gate site, every `matchAll` scrape in aggregator + projector, the projector write gate and store, and a live recount of the projector DB. Disposition classes per #6242: gate-dropped / producer-filtered / safe-helper / internal-constructed-safe / fixed-in-this-phase.

## Contract statement — LANDED
`pm-stack/aggregator/src/model.ts`, directly beside the #4952 `isValidRef` comment: the five rules of #6242 stated where the validity rule lives. PR #7642.

## refUrl / parseRef sites — all classified, none left over

**Safe-helper / guarded at the site (rule 4 treatment, valid → anchor, invalid → plain text or absent):**
- `queue-view.ts:113` and `queue-view.ts:144` — both already `isValidRef(ref) ? refUrl(ref) : undefined` (required disposition 1: stored refs no longer reach `refUrl` unguarded here; nothing owed).
- `render.ts:515` (search badges) — ternary on `isValidRef` (Phase 2 treatment).
- `render.ts:2550` (item refLink, guarded at :2549), `render.ts:2584` (titleHtml), `render.ts:3433` (objective cards) — inline `isValidRef` guards, plain-text/code fallback.
- `render.ts:6533` — this IS the safe-link helper (`poolRefLink`, :6530): `isValidRef ? anchor : label`.
- `brief.ts:97` — blockers are `filter(isValidRef)` at :93 before `refUrl` (rule 4 data form; invalid edges absent, counted at :100).

**Gate-dropped / producer-filtered (rules 2–3, drop is logged or counted):**
- `render.ts:1523` (in-flight board strip) — links come only from `inFlightBoardItems`, whose refs pass the logged `isValidRef` drop at `sources/live.ts:637ff` plus `titleRefs` filtering.
- `render.ts:6820` (project-page roadmap rows) — row links are built by `refsInText` (`sources/live.ts:270`, filtered) and enriched by `projectorLinks` (below).
- `sources/live.ts:658` `parseRef(remainingRefs[0])` — remainingRefs are the `add()`-filtered set (every candidate `isValidRef`-checked, drops logged); parseRef is called only on a survivor.
- `sources/live.ts` `projectorLinks` (:498) — stored registry rows failing `isValidRef` are dropped at the read boundary WITH a `console.error` warning (#6211, rule 2 + rule 5).

**Internal-constructed-safe (code-built refs; parseRef throw retained by design, rule 1):**
- `model.ts:490/525` — `parseRef`/`refUrl` definitions; `model.ts:506` is `isValidRef` itself; `model.ts:520` `refsInText` filters candidates (producer-filtered).
- `program.ts:50-51`, `project-config.ts:550` — refs built from numeric helpers (`issue(n)`, `code(309)`).
- `sources/fixtures.ts:48,230` — fixture builders from code-constructed refs.
- `project-config.ts:648` — `parseRef` inside `checkRefs` try/catch validation (never throws at render, per its own header).
- `render.ts:6835` (per-repo tracked refs) — refs come from project-config entries validated by `checkRefs`, joined against the items map.
- `sources/live.ts:371` — required disposition 2, see below.

**Fixed in this phase:**
- `render.ts:1939` `sessionRecordLine` — required disposition 5, see below.

## The seven required dispositions

1. **queue-view.ts:113,139 (now :113,:144)** — already guarded at both sites (`isValidRef` ternary). Class: safe-helper. Nothing owed.
2. **sources/live.ts:368 (now :371) `mapProjectorComment`** — the `row.url ?? refUrl(row.ref, …)` fallback. `row.ref` is projector-constructed: the projector builds comment/item refs as `itemRef(repo, number)` from parsed GitHub API objects (`pm-stack/projector/src/projector.ts:83,218,253,288`), and its comment projection was rebuilt under the store's legacy-schema guard (`store.ts:31`). Class: internal-constructed-safe. The stored-row risk that applies to pmp_links does not apply here — links are a separate table with their own read-boundary filter (projectorLinks, above).
3. **comments.ts:494 `githubCommentUrl`** — every stored comment's `githubRef` IS guaranteed valid: the POST validator rejects an invalid `githubRef` for kind=github (`comments.ts:122`), and the store-load validator returns an error for the same shape (`comments.ts:68`), so an invalid value can neither enter nor be re-admitted. Class: gate-guaranteed (rule 2's POST-reject carve-out). No guard owed at :494.
4. **render.ts:3574 (now :3641) `ensure()` in reconciledInProgress** — post-#6205 state: every caller guards. Pool items reach `signal()` only after the `isProjectPoolItem` gate (valid `ref` + edge fields); lined-up refs are `isValidRef`-guarded at :3664/:3672 with the #6205 comments; title-scraped refs are guarded at :3673; board-item links come from the filtered producers above. `ensure()`'s `refUrl(ref)` fallback is reachable only with a valid ref by construction of its call sites. Class: safe-by-callers, evidence as listed. Nothing owed.
5. **sessionRecordLine (render.ts:1912, now :1930)** — ALIGNED in this phase (PR #7642): the try/catch that silently omitted an invalid ref is replaced by the rule-4 treatment — valid → anchor, invalid → plain text (`esc(ref)`), matching `poolRefLink` and tierItemCard (#6149). Pinned by `test/ref-contract-6243.test.ts` (unsafe-integer + non-GitHub probes, valid control).
6. **Stored pmp_links recount** — live projector DB (`~/.local/state/pm-projector/projector.db`, read-only, 2026-11-08): **0 rows in pmp_links, so 0 rows fail isValidRef** (table verified alongside pmp_items 13,321 / pmp_comments 61,223, so the DB read is the live one). Phase 2's consumption filtering (`projectorLinks` drop + log) stands as the disarming layer for any future legacy/seeded row; no hand-deletion required or performed.
7. **Raw matchAll ref scrapes** — full sweep of aggregator + projector src: the only ref-shaped scrapes are `titleRefs` (`sources/live.ts:561,571` — both route through the `isValidRef`-filtering `add()`), `refsInText` (`model.ts:518` — filtered), and the overview title scrape (`render.ts:3668` — `isValidRef`-guarded before use). All other `matchAll` hits are date/client/window patterns, not refs. No unfiltered ref scrape exists. Class: producer-filtered, nothing owed.

## Gates, scrapes and store paths (remainder of the sweep)
- Feed gates: `feed.ts` lined-up gate keeps non-GitHub string refs legal at the gate by design (goal ids, #6149) with consumers guarding (#6174/#6205 comments at :249); pool gate `isProjectPoolItem`/`poolFromFeed` drops a malformed-edge item, never the section; orchestration consumption drops invalid lined-up refs with a log (`sources/live.ts` in-flight drop, `work-items` assembly per #6174).
- Pool/epic consumers: `epics.ts:28,48`, `graph.ts:87,98`, `epic-graph.ts:261-307,340,435` — invalid edges filtered/absent, items retained (Phase 3 treatment).
- Search: `search-view.ts:133,180` filters refs before render; render side guarded (:515).
- Server/registry: `server.ts:576` filters registry + tier refs; `registry.ts` admission via `isSessionRecord`; actions/comments POST validators reject invalid refs (#4952 behaviour retained).
- Projector: `POST /links` gate is `isStorableLinkRef` (`pm-stack/projector/src/server.ts:116`) — shape + safe-integer, semantically aligned with `parseRef` (rule 1, cross-app, #6211). No projector refUrl/parseRef call sites exist.

## Probes / tests (PR #7642)
`bun test test/ref-contract-6243.test.ts test/registry-ref-filter-6211.test.ts test/queue-view.test.ts` → 18 pass, 0 fail (laptop worktree). Known unrelated: `test/board-in-flight.test.ts` has 1 pre-existing failure on clean main (stash-verified this shift). Typecheck not runnable in a fresh worktree (bun types absent); CI covers it.

**Phase 4 status: inventory complete, no site unclassified, one site fixed (disposition 5), no follow-up issues owed.** Remaining acceptance item: PR #7642 merged.
